老宅堂屋里，李红霞正在纳鞋底。

徐青青坐在炕上看电视，声音开得老大。

林海柱蹲在门口抽旱烟。

林国强推门进来的时候，三个人都愣了一下。

“国强？你咋来了？”李红霞放下鞋底。

林国强没坐，站在屋子中间，看了眼那台新电视机，然后笑了。

“妈，听说你给老三买了电视机？”

李红霞脸色不自然：“嗯……你们兄弟几个，就老三家里没有，就给他买了一台。”

“还给大嫂买了手表？”

“那是……”

“都是你儿子，凭啥就我没有？”

林国强声音不大，但每个字都清清楚楚。

李红霞张了张嘴：“你不是有吗？你自己买的。”

“那是我自己挣的。”林国强看着她，“不是你们给我买的。”

李红霞脸色变了：“国强，你说这话啥意思？”

“我的意思很明白。”

林国强环顾了一圈，“大哥家的电视，是他自己买的。

我家的电视，也是我自己买的。

老三家的电视，是你跟爹出钱买的。

大嫂的手表，也是你们出钱买的，我没说错吧？”

没人吭声。

徐青青感受到林国强身上的气势，把电视声音关小了，缩在炕角不敢说话。

“妈，爹，我今天来就是想问问，凭啥？”林国强说。

“三个儿子，老大你们帮了，老三你们帮了，就老二啥都没有。”

“妈，爹，我就想问一句，我是你们亲生的吗？”

这句话一出，李红霞脸上挂不住了。

“国强！你说啥胡话呢！”

“不是胡话。”

林国强看着她，“我就是想不通，都是爹娘的儿子，凭啥我老是吃亏？”

林海柱蹲在门口，烟杆子都快捏断了，一句话说不出来。

“以前我傻。”

林国强说，“你们说啥就是啥，让干啥就干啥，吃多大亏也不吭声，但那是以前。”

“从今天起，谁让我不爽，我就闹翻了天。”

“都是爹娘的儿子，凭啥偏心？”

他声音越来越大，院门外已经围了几个邻居，探头探脑地往里看。

李红霞急了：“国强，你别嚷嚷，让人听见笑话……”

“我不怕笑话。”林国强打断她，“我怕的是，你们都觉得我好欺负。”

In the main room of the old house, Li Hongxia was collecting shoe soles.

Xu Qingqing sat on the kang and watched TV with the volume turned up loud.

Lin Haizhu squatted at the door and smoked a cigarette.

When Lin Guoqiang opened the door and came in, the three of them were stunned for a moment.

"Guoqiang? Why are you here?" Li Hongxia put down the soles of her shoes.

Lin Guoqiang did not sit down, but stood in the middle of the room, glanced at the new TV, and then smiled.

"Mom, I heard that you bought the third child a TV?"

Li Hongxia's expression was unnatural: "Well... among you brothers, only the third child doesn't have one at home, so I bought him one."

"You also bought a watch for your sister-in-law?"

"That's..."

"They are all your sons, why am I not the only one?"

Lin Guoqiang's voice was not loud, but every word was clear.

Li Hongxia opened her mouth: "Don't you have it? You bought it yourself."

"I earned that myself." Lin Guoqiang looked at her, "You didn't buy it for me."

Li Hongxia's expression changed: "Guoqiang, what do you mean by this?"

"What I mean is clear."

Lin Guoqiang looked around and said, "The eldest brother's TV was bought by himself.

I also bought my own TV.

You and dad paid for the TV in the third child’s house.

You paid for your sister-in-law's watch, am I right?"

No one said a word.

Xu Qingqing felt Lin Guoqiang's aura, turned down the TV sound, and huddled in the corner of the bed, not daring to speak.

"Mom, Dad, I came today just to ask, why?" Lin Guoqiang said.

"Three sons, you help the eldest, you help the third, but the second has nothing."

"Mom, Dad, I just want to ask, am I your biological child?"

As soon as these words came out, Li Hongxia couldn't help but feel embarrassed.

"Guoqiang! What nonsense are you talking about!"

"It's not nonsense."

Lin Guoqiang looked at her, "I just can't figure it out. We are both my parents' sons. Why do I always suffer?"

Lin Haizhu squatted at the door, the cigarette rod was almost broken, and he couldn't say a word.

"I used to be stupid."

Lin Guoqiang said, "You do whatever you say, you do whatever you are told, and you don't say anything even if you suffer big losses, but that was before."

"From today on, anyone who displeases me will cause a quarrel with me."

"We are all the sons of our parents, why should we be partial?"

His voice became louder and louder, and several neighbors had gathered outside the courtyard gate, peering in.

Li Hongxia was anxious: "Guoqiang, don't yell and let people hear the joke..."

"I'm not afraid of jokes." Lin Guoqiang interrupted her, "What I'm afraid of is that you all think I'm easy to bully."
